subject: Request: Bespoke POC runway variance & credit uplift for Cobalt Systems
messages:
From: Alex Bryant <alex@cobaltsys.com>
To: Priyom Das <pri@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: pilot timeline — need more runway

Priyom,

Thanks again for a thorough demo last week. We scoped a small integration and the team is excited, but we ran into two blockers that will prevent us from completing the POC within the standard 30-day PLG window:

- Security review (SOC 2 evidence requests) is taking longer than expected — procurement asked for a short summary doc and a short demo of audit logs.
- Our engineering team needs a second run at end-to-end latency testing with our internal dataset; that will add ~3 weeks of work.

We'd like to request a 30-day extension plus an additional 150k token credit pool (we expect ~120k tokens over the extra period) so we can finish evaluation with the performance gates satisfied. This is a strategic procurement for us — if POC passes, we plan a multi-region rollout in H2.

Can Redwood accommodate an extension and temporary credit uplift? If helpful, I can share the mutual action plan and procurement contacts.

—Alex
Alex Bryant
Head of ML Platform, Cobalt Systems

From: Priyom Das <pri@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Sep 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: pilot timeline — need more runway

Marissa / Rishi — forwarding a request from Cobalt. Short ask: 30-day extension + 150k token uplift to complete security and latency testing.

Context (TL;DR):
- ARR motion likely >$300k ARR in first 12 months if POC passes and we win procurement.
- They are on our standard PLG 30-day trial; their security team needs the SOC summary and a quick audit-logs walkthrough to sign off.
- Engineering needs to re-run tests at scale; without extra tokens they’ll time out.

Proposal I recommend for Deal Desk approval:
1) One-time 30-day extension to the sandbox/POC window.
2) 150k token credit (adjustable to 125k if you prefer conservative uplift).
3) Condition: they sign the mutual action plan (attached) and agree to a procurement timeline (procurement contact CC'd once approved).

Attachments: Cobalt_Mutual_Action_Plan_v3.pdf, Security_Readout_Summary.docx

Ask: Exec sign-off or direction on limits/alternate contingencies. If approved, I’ll coordinate finance/CS for tagging and expiration.

Thanks — Pri
Priyom Das
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <pri@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Sep 2028 08:56:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: pilot timeline — need more runway

Priyom — thanks for the concise ask. A few notes from me:

- I agree this is strategic and worth keeping moving. Cobalt's platform aligns with our mid-market play and procurement cadence looks sane.
- Finance will likely push to cap credits and require tagging so we can report spend against the campaign.

I am comfortable approving a constrained uplift: 120k token credit + 30-day extension, contingent on:
  * Signed mutual action plan (itemized milestones and expected procurement close date).
  * CS (Monica) to own the onboarding tasks and verify completion of the security walkthrough.

If Rishi can provide exec sign-off on the variance from standard PLG limits (they're asking materially above the free quota), I’ll queue Deal Desk to issue credits. If we need to be more aggressive (i.e., 150k), note I will need an explicit redline from Finance and a short justification for internal audit.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
VP, Sales — SMB & Midmarket
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <pri@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Sep 2028 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: pilot timeline — need more runway

Marissa, Priyom — I appreciate the framing. I approve the variance as follows:

- Approved: 30-day POC extension and 150k token credit (one-time), to be issued as tagged complimentary credits for DEAL-2028-0487.
- Conditions:
  1) Mutual Action Plan signed by Cobalt procurement (attachment).
  2) CS to complete security walkthrough and confirm via short acceptance email to billing@redwoodinference.com.
  3) Credits expire 60 days after issuance if not used.

Monica — please coordinate with Finance for tagging and with Priyom for timing; label spend with campaign tag "Q3-2028-Cobalt-POC". Priyom — after you confirm procurement contact, loop me on the signature email so I have a record.

Thanks — Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Chief Revenue Officer, Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <pri@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Bryant <alex@cobaltsys.com>, procurement@cobaltsys.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 27 Sep 2028 14:42:00 -0700
Subject: Approved: 30-day extension + one-time credits for Cobalt Systems (DEAL-2028-0487)

Alex / Cobalt procurement — great news. Execs approved a one-time runway variance: 30 extra days for your sandbox plus a 150k token complimentary credit pool to complete security and latency validation.

What happens next:
- I’ve attached the latest Mutual Action Plan for signature (Cobalt_Mutual_Action_Plan_v3.pdf). Please sign and return to me and cc procurement@redwoodinference.com.
- Monica will schedule a 45-minute security walkthrough with your security lead to cover SOC artifacts and audit logs. Expect an invite within 48 hours.
- Finance will tag the credit issuance to campaign "Q3-2028-Cobalt-POC"; credits will expire 60 days after issuance.

Quick ask from procurement: please confirm the name and email for the signee and an expected sign date (we ideally need signature within 5 business days to keep the momentum).

Happy to jump on a quick call if needed.

—Pri
Priyom Das
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Cobalt_Mutual_Action_Plan_v3.pdf (application/pdf), Security_Readout_Summary.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)
